title: Test of Love
description: Codeforces problem CF1992D - Test of Love
expected_approach: Use DP or greedy: keep track of minimum swim meters needed to reach each position or greedily jump to the furthest reachable logs/banks while minimizing swimming.

test_cases.explanation: Sample 1: jumps allow crossing without swimming.
Sample 3: insufficient swim capacity for required water segments.
Sample 6: jump directly into water and swim once within k.
